project.title: Study: Whole transcriptomic analysis of Caenibius tardaugens NBRC 16725 grown in cholate and testosterone
project.description: Whole transcriptomic analysis of Caenibius tardaugens NBRC 16725 grown in cholate and progesterone as sole carbon sources. The objective of this project is to identify genes involved in bacterial cholate metabolism using testosterone condition as control.

samples: Activated sludge of a sewage treatment plant
Activated sludge of a sewage treatment plant of Tokio, Japan
runs: RNA-seq of Caenibius tardaugens: Cholate replicates 1 to 3
RNA-seq of Caenibius tardaugens: Testosterone replicates 1 to 3
